title: Federal judge calls Flock ‘indiscriminate mass surveillance’
snippet: A federal judge ruled that a sheriff’s deputy violated a woman’s Fourth Amendment rights when using Flock to search for her license plate without a warrant.

title: Amazon responds to data center backlash, says it no longer uses NDAs
snippet: The CEO of Amazon Web Services tried to push back against widespread suspicion of data centers.

title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
snippet: By his own admission, David Robinson is “something of a cliché”: an employee at a leading AI company who issues a dire warning while resigning from their job.
